description: React component for managing and displaying installed outgoing webhooks in Mattermost, including loading, sorting, filtering, and rendering webhook items.

classes.name: InstalledOutgoingWebhooks
classes.description: React component class for displaying and managing outgoing webhooks in Mattermost.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Loads outgoing webhooks and profiles for the team when component mounts, if webhooks are enabled.

methods.name: regenOutgoingWebhookToken
methods.description: Regenerates the token for a specified outgoing webhook.

methods.name: outgoingWebhookCompare
methods.description: Compares two outgoing webhooks for sorting based on display name or channel name.

methods.name: outgoingWebhooks
methods.description: Filters, sorts, and maps outgoing webhooks to React components based on a search filter.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the list of outgoing webhooks with header, add button, help text, and search placeholder.
